releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.35 — messaging is instant again and voice notes actually arrive. The chat now merges what the server knows with what you just sent instead of replacing the whole history (that is what made a new message vanish), the server's own echo of your message updates the bubble, and a send retries three times before giving up — and then says so, with a red warning you can tap to resend. Voice notes: uploads now survive an expired login token (they used to fail silently), the recording survives a flaky MediaRecorder, the wire carries the length in seconds like the web client, and any failure is shown instead of being swallowed. The leftover mock attachment path is gone.
